primitives.verbatim_quote: That is, the performance of an offensive lineman conceding a pressure 1 second after the snap is considered equal to that of a lineman who concedes pressure after 2.4 seconds, and likewise the metric offers no distinction for the degree of protection the quarterback enjoys.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight of the framework lies in redefining offensive line effectiveness through spatial-temporal lens rather than traditional counting stats. PBWR captures block sustainability but lacks nuance in timing and degree of protection. Pocket occupancy dynamics introduce a geometric abstraction of the quarterback’s protected zone, modeled via Voronoi diagrams to reflect spatial dominance. Pressure onset timing reveals a critical flaw in existing metrics—uniform treatment of pressure events despite varying impact. These primitives form a dual structure: one temporal (PBWR, pressure timing) and one spatial (pocket dynamics), enabling a richer, multi-dimensional model of line performance. Failure modes include oversimplification of pressure severity and static pocket assumptions. The framework thus bridges discrete event counting with continuous spatial analysis.
